instruction: `slugify(text)` in slugs.py is buggy. The intended behavior (see its docstring) is: Unicode-normalize with NFKD and drop combining marks so accented Latin letters become plain ASCII ('Crème Brûlée' -> 'creme-brulee'); lowercase; every run of one or more characters that are not ASCII letters or digits becomes a single '-'; no leading or trailing '-'; any characters with no ASCII form (e.g. '日本') are dropped like punctuation; an empty or all-punctuation input returns ''. An optional `max_length` truncates the slug to at most that many characters without leaving a trailing '-'. Fix slugify so it matches the docstring. All tests in tests/test_slugs.py must pass.
